url.description: The URL to deliver webhook payloads to.

event_types.description:
Event types to subscribe to. Must contain at least one event type.
Valid event types: `request.received`, `request.success`, `request.redirect`,
`request.client_error`, `request.server_error`, `request.timeout`,
`request.error`, `request.completed`, `audit.event`. The full catalog
is available at `GET /webhooks/event-types`.

`audit.event` delivers every audit entry, with sanitised `details`, to
this URL. Creating a webhook subscribed to it, or making any change to one
that stays subscribed (including a rename or `enabled: false`), requires
what reading `details` requires: `audit_log:list` for an API key or OAuth
client, or an Admin or Owner holder for a user-bound token. Otherwise the
request is refused with `403 forbidden`. An OAuth token narrowed by scope
must also hold a scope that reads the audit log (`audit-logs:read`), or
the request is refused with `403 insufficient_scope`. Deleting the
webhook is not affected.

request_headers.description: Custom headers to include with delivery requests.

route_filter.description: Optional route ID to scope events to a single route.

include_request_body.description: Include the original request body in the payload.

include_response_body.description: Include the upstream response body in the payload.

include_headers.description: Include request/response headers in the payload.

enabled.description: Whether the webhook is active on creation.

hmac_key_id.description: Sign deliveries with this transit (crypto) key instead of the webhook's generated `secret_key`.

hmac_format.description: Wire format for the HMAC signature header.

hmac_header_name.description: Header carrying the signature. Required when `hmac_format` is `custom`.
